settings.title: Settings
privacy.body: Your location is used on this device to show where you are and to guide you. It is only sent when you choose to send a report, and then only the reported spot is stored. Reviews and reports are linked to your account so the community model can learn whose reports are reliable; other people only see combined alerts, never your name.
help.body: Roads and buildings come from OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). Places also come from Overture Maps. District boundaries come from OCHA / HDX. Satellite imagery is Esri World Imagery; the street map is OpenStreetMap. Routes are planned by OSRM through the Magaalo website, using OpenStreetMap roads. Community alerts and reviewed details come from Magaalo users. Map data can be incomplete or out of date.
